answer: Require every identity to post a collateral bond that doubles per identity traced to the same funding source: 1 costs 1 unit, 2 costs 2, 3 costs 4, and so on. The escrow follows the funding graph, so scattering coins across fresh wallets still aggregates under the shared funder. Each identity is a pier of the same bridge and must carry its own bonded load. Fraudulent attestations slash the bond; honest bonds release slowly over 90 days. One identity is a marble; N identities become a plume of cost near 2^N. Honest users pay once; a sybil farmer's cost grows exponentially with N.
